explanation: The Almighty Creator who is completely righteous, patient toward sinners, but also an avenger against those who mock him.
The title of the eternal and sovereign God who governs the course of history and judges nations.
A description of God's wrath that rages uncontrollably against his enemies, like a storm or fire.
The just punishment God gives to the wicked for their injustice and cruelty.
The attribute of God showing that he does not immediately unleash his wrath but grants time for repentance before judgment falls.
A description of God's power when he intervenes to punish the ungodly and break their power.
Symbolize stability and eternity, yet they are shaken under God's wrath, showing that nothing can stand against him.
Represents the forces of nature that dry up or flood when God advances to punish sin.
The Assyrian capital, known for its cruelty and now standing under God's judgment because of its sins.
